from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

root=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics')
base=root/'docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_author_source_reception'
result=json.loads((base/'RESULT.json').read_bytes())
native=json.loads((base/'NATIVE01.json').read_bytes())
assert native['native']['exit_code']==0
assert json.loads(native['native']['output'])==result
assert result['before']==result['after']
checked={}
for phase in ('before','after'):
    for name,key in result[phase].items():
        p=Path(name); body=p.read_bytes(); st=p.stat()
        actual={'bytes':len(body),'sha256':sha256(body).hexdigest(),'mode':st.st_mode,'mtime_ns':st.st_mtime_ns}
        assert actual==key,name
        checked[name]=actual
for label in ('copy_complete_source','compare_complete_source'):
    attempt=json.loads((base/(label+'.ATTEMPT.json')).read_bytes())
    receipt=json.loads((base/(label+'.RECEIPT.json')).read_bytes())
    assert all(receipt[k]==v for k,v in attempt.items())
    assert receipt['exit_code']==0
    for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
        b=(base/(label+'.'+stream+'.raw')).read_bytes()
        assert receipt[stream]=={'bytes':len(b),'sha256':sha256(b).hexdigest()}
        assert b==b''
controls=root/'docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/control_before_p212_source_accepted'
for row in json.loads((controls/'MAPPING.json').read_bytes()):
    b=Path(row['physical_original']).read_bytes()
    assert {'bytes':len(b),'sha256':sha256(b).hexdigest()}==row['pin']
    for kind in ('copy_','cmp_'):
        label=kind+Path(row['logical_path']).name
        receipt=json.loads((controls/(label+'.RECEIPT.json')).read_bytes())
        assert receipt['exit_code']==0
        for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
            b=(controls/(label+'.'+stream+'.raw')).read_bytes()
            assert b==b''
            assert receipt[stream]=={'bytes':0,'sha256':sha256(b).hexdigest()}
links=[]
for p in (base/'RECEPTION.md',base/'ROLE_DECISION.md',root/'SYMBOLIC_DYNAMICS_STATE.md',root/'docs/papers211_215_sequence/PIPELINE_STATE.md'):
    for dest in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
        if dest.startswith(('http:','https:','#')): continue
        target=(p.parent/dest.split('#')[0]).resolve()
        assert target.exists(),(str(p),dest,str(target))
        links.append({'from':str(p),'link':dest,'resolved':str(target)})
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS_POST_P212_SOURCE_INDEX_ONLY','scientific_executions':0,'full_original_keys_checked_twice':len(checked),'keys':checked,'links':links,'link_count':len(links)},sort_keys=True))
